You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To use henna for skin, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sift the raw henna powder through a fine mesh (10 minutes)
Step 2. Measure out the lemon juice (2 minutes)
Step 3. Test a small patch of skin for allergies (24 hours)
Step 4. Clean the application area with rubbing alcohol (3 minutes)
Step 5. Transfer the henna paste into a piping bag (5 minutes)
Step 6. Mix the powder with the acidic liquid (15 minutes)
Step 7. Research traditional henna patterns for inspiration (1 hour)
Step 8. Add essential oils like eucalyptus or lavender to the mix (2 minutes)
Step 9. Let the paste rest for dye release (12 hours)
Step 10. Whisk the paste until it reaches a stringy consistency (10 minutes)
Step 11. Prepare a sugar and lemon sealant spray (10 minutes)
Step 12. Buy high-quality organic henna powder (1 hour)
Step 13. Cut the tip of the applicator cone (1 minute)
Step 14. Gather cotton swabs for cleaning up mistakes (2 minutes)
Step 15. Prepare a workspace with good lighting (10 minutes)
Step 16. Wash your hands thoroughly (3 minutes)
Step 17. Sketch the design on a piece of paper (30 minutes)
Step 18. Exfoliate the skin area to be decorated (5 minutes)
Step 19. Strain the mixed paste through a nylon stocking (15 minutes)
Step 20. Order cellophane sheets for making cones (20 minutes)
Step 21. Roll the cellophane into tight cones (30 minutes)
Step 22. Sanitize all mixing bowls and spoons (5 minutes)
Step 23. Practice drawing lines on a glass plate (45 minutes)
Step 24. Warm the lemon juice slightly (1 minute)
Step 25. Check the paste for any remaining lumps (5 minutes)
Step 26. Fill the handmade cones with the henna paste (10 minutes)
Step 27. Set up a comfortable chair for the recipient (5 minutes)
Step 28. Print out reference photos (5 minutes)
Step 29. Apply the henna design to the skin (2 hours)
Step 30. Lay out paper towels to catch drips (2 minutes)
Step 31. Let the applied henna dry until it cracks (1 hour)
Step 32. Mist the design with the sugar sealant (2 minutes)
Step 33. Tape the end of the henna cone shut (2 minutes)
Step 34. Ensure the room temperature is warm (1 minute)
Step 35. Prepare a cup of tea for the artist (10 minutes)
Step 36. Dry the skin surface completely (2 minutes)
Step 37. Remove any jewelry from the application site (1 minute)
Step 38. Fold the top of the henna cone (3 minutes)
Step 39. Apply a thin layer of olive oil to the skin (2 minutes)
Step 40. Put on an apron to protect clothes (1 minute)
Step 41. Position the hand or foot on a steady surface (2 minutes)
Step 42. Tie back long hair (1 minute)
Step 43. Secure the cone with a rubber band (1 minute)
Step 44. Inspect the henna powder for a green hue (2 minutes)
Step 45. Add a teaspoon of sugar to the paste for stickiness (1 minute)
Step 46. Seal the cone with adhesive tape (2 minutes)
Step 47. Watch a tutorial on intricate leaf patterns (20 minutes)
Step 48. Select the finest nozzle size (2 minutes)
Step 49. Map out the design lightly with a skin marker (15 minutes)
Step 50. Clear a space on the table for the arm to rest (5 minutes)
Step 51. Allow the paste to reach room temperature (30 minutes)
Step 52. Moisturize the surrounding skin (2 minutes)
Step 53. Gather all necessary ingredients and tools (15 minutes)
Step 54. Stir the paste one last time (2 minutes)
Step 55. Squeeze the cone to test the flow (1 minute)
Step 56. Apply a base layer of eucalyptus oil to the skin (2 minutes)
Step 57. Check the acidity of the lemon juice (2 minutes)
Step 58. Wipe the tip of the cone with a damp cloth (30 seconds)
Step 59. Tape the cone seams for extra durability (5 minutes)
Step 60. Clean the mixing area (10 minutes)
